connector.name: HCM MCP Server for Oracle Fusion Cloud (unofficial)
connector.registryDescription: Open-source, write-capable MCP server for Oracle Fusion HCM. Safe by default. Unofficial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package fusion-hcm-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mohantyajitesh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HCM_BASE_URL
env.description: Oracle Fusion pod base URL, e.g. https://your-pod.fa.us6.oraclecloud.com

env.name: HCM_USERNAME
env.description: Fusion integration user (least-privilege, read-only HCM roles recommended)

env.name: HCM_PASSWORD
env.description: Integration user password (basic auth). Alternatively store in the OS credential store under service 'fusion-hcm-mcp-server' and omit this.

env.name: CONFIG_FILE
env.description: Optional path to a config.toml for advanced settings (modules, feature flags, OAuth2, limits). Env vars override file values.
